callouts.title: Start
callouts.text: Opens the song library of Play Mode. Enter does the same.
callouts.name: LaunchStartButton

callouts.title: Playing as
callouts.text: The profile your scores and settings are saved under. Switch or add profiles here, or play as a guest.
callouts.name: LaunchWhoPanel

callouts.title: Library status
callouts.text: How many songs DotCharter found in your library folder.
callouts.name: LaunchLibraryChip

callouts.title: Guitar input
callouts.text: Whether an instrument input is set up and its latency is known. Play Mode needs it to score you.
callouts.name: LaunchInputChip

callouts.title: Navigation rail
callouts.text: The app's destinations: Home (recent projects and what to do next), Library (your songs), Chart (the editor), Rig (your tone) and Settings.
callouts.name: ActivityRail

callouts.title: Menu bar
callouts.text: All editor commands, grouped by menu. Each menu is shown in Charting a song.
callouts.name: EditorMenuBar

callouts.title: Go to anything
callouts.text: A command palette: type part of a command, setting or song and press Enter.
callouts.name: TitleGoToAnything

callouts.title: Toolbar
callouts.text: Transport, grid snap, undo, zoom and the most used tools.
callouts.name: EditorToolbar

callouts.title: Status bar
callouts.text: Messages, running tasks, the playhead position and the chart's issue count.
callouts.name: StatusBarView

callouts.title: Library folder
callouts.text: The folder DotCharter scans for songs. Browse picks another one, Refresh scans again.
callouts.name: LibraryFolderBar

callouts.title: Search
callouts.text: Filters by title, artist or album as you type.
callouts.name: LibrarySearchField

callouts.title: Columns
callouts.text: Click a column to sort by it; the funnel icons filter by paths, tuning, year, difficulty and length.
callouts.name: LibraryColumnHeader

callouts.title: Songs
callouts.text: Grouped by artist. The letters L, R and B show which paths (lead, rhythm, bass) a song has.
callouts.name: LibraryRows

callouts.title: Song details
callouts.text: The selected song, with each path and its note count. Pick the path to load.
callouts.name: LibraryDetail

callouts.title: Load chart
callouts.text: Opens the chosen path in the editor. It replaces the open project, so save first.
callouts.name: LibraryLoad
